entry.tide:
use route

main a:i b:i > i
route a b

versandetiketten.contract: At most b packages. Issue b standard labels and two reserve labels per package, or -99 above capacity.
versandetiketten.tide_route:
use rulebook

route a:i b:i > i
let labels compute a b
if (< a b) labels -99
versandetiketten.python_route:
from rulebook import compute

def route(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    labels = compute(a, b)
    return labels if a < b else -99

nettogewicht.contract: Subtract b from a when a is at most b, otherwise return -99.

taktfenster.contract: Return the offset in the first cycle of length b. At or beyond the next cycle, return -99.
taktfenster.tide_route:

lackbedarf.contract: The paint required at rate a for a square of side length b.
lackbedarf.tide_route:
use rulebook

route a:i b:i > i
- (compute a b) b

restladung.contract: Charge three units per item that does not fit in full trays of capacity b.
restladung.tide_route:
use rulebook

route a:i b:i > i
+ (compute a b) 3
